newsitem.title: FINLAND: BALTIC INVESTMENT CONFERENCE OPENS IN HELSINKI.
newsitem.headline: BALTIC INVESTMENT CONFERENCE OPENS IN HELSINKI.

text.p: A conference focusing on investment in Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia opened in the Finnish capital on Monday with the participation of bankers, financiers and corporate officials.
The conference aims to share the experiences of existing investors in the Baltic market and to introduce new investors on how to set up in the three countries.
"The question is no longer if they should invest, but when and how," Coopers and Lybrand partner Nils Melngailis told the conference as it opened.
His words were backed up by Juris Ulmanis, business development manager for mobile phone giant Motorola in the region.
"The time is now to invest in the Baltics," he said.
